name: jira_boards_list
description: Returns all boards, optionally filtered by project key or board type (GET /rest/agile/1.0/board)

project_key.description: Filters results to boards relevant to a project, for example RECON.

board_type.description: Filters results to boards of the specified type. Valid values: scrum, kanban.

limit.description: The maximum number of boards to return per page. Default: 30.
